basic_profile.bio: A history enthusiast with a penchant for strategy games, especially those developed by Paradox Interactive. Originally from Chicago, I'm a software engineer by day and a gamer by night. I enjoy dissecting historical events and often find myself lost in discussions about alternate histories and what-ifs. My typical online hours are late evenings after work, usually around 8 PM to midnight CST. In a committed relationship, my partner often joins me in my gaming adventures. Dislikes include overly simplistic narratives and lack of attention to historical detail.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a lifelong passion for history, I bring a unique blend of technical expertise and historical knowledge to my Reddit interactions. My interest in history is largely self-taught, fueled by countless hours of reading and gaming. I often share insights from both my professional and personal experiences.
